description: Land Title Settlement Dept. -  Notice calling for claims to land parcels - Kotawehera D/S Division   - Cad. Map. No.421157  and others
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title claims and registration processes under the Registration of Title Act. It involves calling for claims to specific land parcels, referencing cadastral maps, land boundaries, and the process for determining land ownership. The content focuses entirely on land matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories like legal frameworks (though it references an act, the content itself is about land administration rather than creating new legislation).
